text:
Samira G: Postmortem follow-up from the vendor cascade this morning (cloud IAM throttles -> model-registry errors). I created ACTIONS-1102 in the tracker. Please claim ownership and add concrete ETAs. Link: https://tracker.redwood/actions/ACTIONS-1102

Ben L: I can take registry fallback + snapshot flow. plan: read-through LRU for manifests (ttl=20s), plus a gzipped, signed snapshot for critical configs. ETA to PR: 2026-02-06.

Yuko H: i'll own auth client hardening and alerting. propose jittered exponential backoff and a per-client token-bucket limiter. ETA: 2026-02-04.

ops-bot: Follow-ups created: A-1102-1 (registry-cache), A-1102-2 (auth-retries), A-1102-3 (runbook+kms). Owners must update tracker within 48h.

Rahul M: ops notes - require secondary owner for any action >72h, include vendor ticket ID and contact, and add estimated hours. also add a recurring "vendor-dep resilience" review to the incident cadence. i'll add that to docs.

Iris K: security note - snapshots must be encrypted with KMS, ACL'd, and the signed manifest verified at load time. i'll own runbook updates and the pre-deploy checklist. ETA: 2026-01-31.

Samira G: observed pattern: spikes around credential rotations and long tail retries when registry returns 5xx. short-term mitigations: small local cache, strict retry budgets, and route to dedicated model-variants on failure. also escalate to vendor for per-minute throttle thresholds.

Ben L: cache details i'll put in PR: max_entries=8k, ttl=20s, exclude presigned URLs. snapshot will be versioned and signed. integration test will simulate registry 5xx -> snapshot fallback.

Yuko H: proposed auth snippet (will open PR):
```
retry_policy: exponential
initial_backoff_ms: 200
max_retries: 3
max_backoff_ms: 3000
jitter: true
token_bucket: rate=60/s, burst=120
circuit_breaker: failures=10, window=60s
```
should limit retry amplification and create a clear alerting signal.

ops-bot: Vendor ticket placeholder required. Please paste vendor support ID in the tracker.

Rahul M: i've started an escalation with cloud support: CLOUD-AUTH-33321. ask vendor for explicit throttle thresholds and suggested client configs.

Iris K: i'll update runbook with encryption/KMS steps and include a checklist for signed manifests. also add guidance on who rotates KMS keys after snapshot refresh.

Samira G: ops governance for these actions: mark status (in_progress/blocked/done), add estimated hours, assign a secondary owner for >72h, tag cross-team PRs with "ops-review-required", and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to confirm ETAs.

Ben L: claimed A-1102-1, PR draft in ~3h.

Yuko H: claimed A-1102-2, opening vendor case for auth details and will update tracker.

Iris K: claimed A-1102-3 and will push runbook edits today.

Rahul M: i'll add the recurring review to the incident cadence and create a short template for the monthly check.

Samira G: please confirm by EOD. i'll summarize to leadership after the sync. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Ben L: confirmed.

Yuko H: confirmed, PR + vendor ID forthcoming.

Iris K: confirmed.

Rahul M: confirmed.
